# HarfBuzzMarkOrder.txt
# Written by tests/tools/derive_harfbuzz_mark_order.py from HarfBuzz 15.0.0. Do not edit.
#
# The order in which HarfBuzz sorts a run of combining marks, from the first sorted to the last.
#   ccc <value>            every character with that Canonical_Combining_Class
#   char <code point>      one character that HarfBuzz sorts apart from its class
#
# The marks that the Arabic shaper of HarfBuzz moves to the start of a run, after the sort.
#   modifier <code point>
#
# Where HarfBuzz places a mark on its base in a font without a GPOS table: how it aligns the mark
# with the base (center, left, right, or double for a mark over two bases), and the side of the base
# (none, below, attached-below, above, attached-above). An attached mark touches the base.
#   place ccc <value> <alignment> <side>         every character with that Canonical_Combining_Class
#   place char <code point> <alignment> <side>   one character that HarfBuzz places apart from its class
